title: [cutover evidence 1of2] Production quiesce-record digest: a daemon-importable evidence serializer
description:
SPLIT OUT OF task-dcf0ce921b5b4ca59db32851ea711924 by architect-1270c677 on 2026-08-29 at HEAD 05264bf1, under governor-0af24e35's 12:40Z re-plan handoff which offered widen-or-split and required children be filed into PLANNING (not BACKLOG - nine rows have died there over two days) with the parent named.

THE GAP, MEASURED AND CONFIRMED INDEPENDENTLY. `serializeLiveEvidence` exists at EXACTLY two paths and both are tests: `tests/migration/cutover-live/live-quiesce-evidence.ts` and its `.test.ts` sibling. `git grep -ln 'serializeLiveEvidence' HEAD -- .` returns those two plus task JSON only. There is NO production definition anywhere under apps/ or packages/.

THIS IS NOT A WIRING GAP. `apps/daemon` cannot import from `tests/`, so the quiesce evidence cannot be composed from where it currently lives - it must be BUILT as a production surface. That distinction is the whole reason this row exists, and it is a correction to the PARENT ROW'S OWN FILING: I wrote the parent's DoD and it said "compose the landed live-quiesce apparatus (tests/migration/cutover-live/) as the artifact source". That instruction was UNBUILDABLE and I am retracting it here rather than leaving a worker to discover it a third time.

WHAT THIS ROW LANDS: a production, daemon-importable serializer for live quiesce evidence, and a server-derived `quiesceRecordSha256` digest over it. The digest is computed from the evidence artifact itself - never supplied, defaulted, or influenced by a caller.

WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN ITS SIZE SUGGESTS. This digest is one of four generations in the v2 cutover activation marker, which exists to detect drift. The chain is: this row -> task-dcf0ce92 (the composing snapshot reader) -> task-b254847909ca4199a70a3a06173f1cd9 (cutover activation tooling) -> task-c4321b6f, the ONE-WAY GA ACTIVATION with no rollback in scope. A fabricated or defaulted digest anywhere in this chain ends up authorising an irreversible activation. governor-0af24e35 ratified a worker's refusal to build injected byte ports for exactly this reason: "an injected port that carries caller bytes is a fabricated authority", and Rail 4 forbids a mock-only P1 boundary.

REUSE, DO NOT REINVENT THE SEMANTICS. The tests/ implementation is the specification for WHAT quiescence evidence means; read it before designing. Move or re-express that meaning into a production module - do NOT invent a second, parallel notion of quiescence that agrees with the tests today and drifts tomorrow. If the honest shape is to relocate the serializer into a package both the daemon and the migration lane can import, say so and do that; if the migration lane's copy then becomes a consumer of the production one, that is the right outcome and its arms must keep passing.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK at claim, recorded in a durable moe.add_comment (the completion summary is write-only and persists nowhere). Re-capture `git rev-parse HEAD` and quote it beside every probe, each UNPIPED with its own exit code and a positive control. An ABSENCE premise probed only with `git grep <rev>` is blind to untracked files by construction and a duplicate row was filed on this board for exactly that reason. A PRODUCTION module - importable by apps/daemon, so under apps/ or packages/ and never under tests/ - serializes live quiesce evidence, and a server-derived `quiesceRecordSha256` is computed over that artifact. The digest derivation is deterministic and byte-stable: the same evidence yields the same digest across processes. A caller-presented digest is REFUSED with an exact stable reason code at a named layer, both asserted.

SEMANTICS ARE PRESERVED, NOT REINVENTED. Read tests/migration/cutover-live/live-quiesce-evidence.ts first and state in a row comment how the production serializer relates to it - relocated, re-expressed, or wrapped - and why the two cannot drift. If the migration lane's arms now consume the production surface, they must still pass; run them and quote the counts. A second parallel notion of quiescence that agrees today is a FINDING to report, not an acceptable outcome.

ABSENCE REFUSES, IT DOES NOT DEFAULT. When the evidence needed to compute the digest is unavailable, the path returns a refusal naming which fact was missing, with its exact code and refusing layer - never a zero digest and never an empty string. A zero-filled digest would compare equal to another zero-filled one and make the drift comparison the cutover marker exists for silently vacuous. A mutation substituting a default for the refusal must red a NAMED arm, and a mutation substituting a DIFFERENT default must red the SAME arm, since absence and a defaulted value are different answers.

A serializer nothing imports satisfies every existence grep while the feature does not exist. apps/daemon CANNOT import from tests/. The production surface must live under apps/ or packages/. Relocating or re-expressing the tests/ semantics is in scope; leaving the only implementation under tests/ and wiring to it is not.

So DO NOT reach for `canonicalDigest`/`sha256Hex` from packages/import/src/canonical-bytes.ts — that would add a new cross-package edge from the lower layer upward. Core ALREADY has its own digest helpers; read how `packages/core/src/planning/acceptance-contract-codec.ts` and `packages/core/src/configuration/project-configuration-manifest.ts` derive theirs and REUSE that approach. (c) EDGE CHECK 2, and it decides whether step 4 is possible at all: `git grep -n '@moe/' HEAD -- tests/migration/cutover-live/ tests/migration/cutover/` currently returns EMPTY — that lane imports NO workspace package today. Before planning to make it consume `@moe/core`, PROVE it can: write a throwaway probe importing a `@moe/core` bare specifier from a file in that directory, typecheck it under the config that lane actually uses, and DELETE it in the same command. If it cannot resolve, say so and treat step 4 as blocked rather than editing the lane — the manifest/tsconfig edge would then be its own work.

=== THE ARCHITECTURAL FINDING THAT SHAPES THIS ROW. Read before designing. ===
The daemon CANNOT PRODUCE this evidence, by construction. The module's own header says so: "the population this row quiesces includes the daemon serving the board, so the process that would otherwise report the result does not survive the stop actions. The record must therefore be writable to a durable file BEFORE the first stop and appendable as each stop happens." The quiesce record is an OPERATOR-RUN MIGRATION ARTIFACT written to a file while the daemon is being stopped.
SO THE HONEST PRODUCTION SURFACE IS NOT "the daemon serializes quiesce evidence". It is: a SHARED CANONICAL SHAPE plus a digest, so the migration lane writes the artifact and the daemon later READS THAT ARTIFACT and DERIVES `quiesceRecordSha256` from its bytes. Digesting an artifact the daemon reads itself is not fabrication — it is the same relationship the daemon has with a distribution manifest. Accepting a digest, or bytes, from a caller WOULD be fabrication, and that is what governor-0af24e35 ratified refusing.

implementationPlan.description:
STEP 2 — RED FIRST, in packages/core. Create `packages/core/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence.test.ts` with arms that fail until step 3 lands.

ARMS:
(1) CANONICAL AND DETERMINISTIC — the same evidence value yields the same digest across two independent serializations, and a value whose keys were INSERTED IN A DIFFERENT ORDER yields the SAME digest. This is the arm that forces a canonical encoding rather than a bare `JSON.stringify`, whose output follows insertion order and would make the digest fragile. Note the existing tests/ serializer is deliberately pretty-printed two-space JSON for human legibility (live-quiesce-evidence.ts:208-210) — that is a DISPLAY form, not a digest form, and step 3 must keep the two distinct.
(2) DIGEST IS OVER THE ARTIFACT — a one-byte change anywhere in the evidence changes the digest. Assert with a concrete mutated field, not a hand-waved "different input".
(3) SHAPE IS EXACT — an evidence record with an unknown extra key, or a missing required key, is REFUSED with an exact stable reason code and its layer, both asserted. The existing module already owns a refusal vocabulary (`LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_CODES` at :36 and `LiveQuiesceEvidenceRefusal` at :49) — reuse those codes rather than minting a parallel set, and say in the row comment which you reused.
(4) NO CALLER DIGEST — the surface takes evidence and DERIVES the digest; it never accepts one. Make that structurally impossible in the signature where you can, refused with a named code where you cannot.
(5) ABSENCE REFUSES, NEVER DEFAULTS — unavailable evidence yields a refusal naming what was missing, never a zero digest or empty string. A zero digest compares equal to another zero digest and makes the drift comparison the cutover marker exists for silently vacuous.

THIS IS THE ANTI-DRIFT GUARANTEE and it is the point of the step: if the shape lives in two places it will agree today and diverge later, which is the third-notion hazard this board has already been burned by. One definition, two consumers.

DO NOT convert `writeLiveEvidence`'s injected `EvidenceWritePorts` into a production surface. That port is a legitimate test-harness seam for a file write; hoisting an injected byte port into production is precisely what governor-0af24e35 ratified refusing, because a port carrying caller bytes is a fabricated authority.

RUN THE MIGRATION LANE'S OWN SUITE UNEDITED afterwards and quote its counts. If any arm reds, you have changed behaviour rather than relocated a definition — stop and report. D2 DEFAULT INSTEAD OF REFUSE: return a zero digest for absent evidence — the absence arm must RED. Then substitute a DIFFERENT default — the SAME arm must RED. Both are required: absence and a defaulted value are different answers and one drill cannot show the arm distinguishes them.
D3 ACCEPT A CALLER DIGEST: let the surface take a digest and return it unchanged — the no-caller-digest arm must RED. This is the fabrication the whole chain exists to prevent.

The module header states the population being quiesced INCLUDES the daemon serving the board, so the record must be written to a durable file BEFORE the first stop.
